description: The universe is too vast to explore by hand, but data makes it possible. Our goal with Cosmic Footprint is to turn NASA SPHEREx data into an open, interactive experience for curious enthusiasts hungry for discoveries, scientists searching for answers, and above all children, allowing them to keep dreaming while looking up at the stars. Whatever your background or skills, anyone is welcome, without any exception. Join us on this journey and let's leave our footprint in the cosmos!
